xml.brief: Set or remove personal coordinates of a geocache

desc.p: This method allows your users to set or remove their own (corrected) coordinates of a geocache, e.g. the solved final location of a mystery cache. Each user has at most one such location per geocache.

Current personal coordinates for the geocache can be retrieved using the my_coords field (or the user-coords entry of the alt_wpts field) in the services/caches/geocache method. Use services/apisrv/installation (has_user_coords) to find out if an installation supports this method.

req.name: cache_code
req.p: Note: On OCPL-based sites, user coordinates are only supported for caches of type Multi, Quiz, and Other. Supplying a cache of any other type will result in an HTTP 400 error.

req.name: user_coords
req.p: The coordinates are defined by a string in the format "lat|lon". An empty string removes the user's coordinates. "0|0" is rejected.

Use positive numbers for latitudes in the northern hemisphere and longitudes in the eastern hemisphere (and negative for southern and western hemispheres accordingly). These are full degrees with a dot as a decimal point (ex. "48.7|15.89").

returns.p: A dictionary of the following structure:

ul.li: my_coords - the user's coordinates as stored now, in the "lat|lon" format, or null if they have been removed.
